issues: CameraMotionBlur 多重采样把米白页面和卡片染成偏黄偏灰，快段每一帧都有色偏
remap 是三段折线，40f/85f 两处速度瞬间从 2.2 跳到 0.2 再跳回，读作卡顿而不是变速
模糊按帧号硬开关（42f/83f），慢窗边界一帧从糊变清，有明显跳变
画面只有一条 460px 宽的卡片导轨悬在大片空底上，看不出是产品页面；慢窗里目标卡只是固定上移 16px，没有"凝视"动作
changes: 速率曲线改为 2.4→0.2→2.4、两处 smoothstep 过渡（30–46f / 80–94f），源帧号取闭式积分，变速像踩刹车/油门
CameraMotionBlur 换成方向性 SpeedBlur，模糊量按 remap 后的实际速度逐帧计算，|v|<8px/f 不挂滤镜，色偏消失、快糊慢清连续过渡
慢窗里目标卡随靠近屏中被"拾起"：抬高 18px、放大 4.5%、阴影 elevation 5→32，其余卡淡出 30%
卡片放大到 540px，顶部挂真实页面导航条，导轨上方加页面原生分组标题（32px），底部柔光 + 暗角 + 颗粒
issuesEn: CameraMotionBlur's multi-sampling tinted the off-white page and cards yellow-grey on every fast frame
The remap was a three-segment polyline, so speed jumped instantly from 2.2 to 0.2 and back at 40f/85f, reading as a stutter rather than a ramp
Blur was switched on and off by frame number (42f/83f), so the slow window snapped from blurry to sharp in one frame
The frame was just a 460px card rail floating in empty space with no sign of a product page; in the slow window the target card was merely offset 16px with no 'look closer' beat
changesEn: Rate curve is now 2.4→0.2→2.4 with two smoothstep transitions (30–46f / 80–94f), and source frames come from its closed-form integral, so the ramp feels like braking and accelerating
Replaced CameraMotionBlur with directional SpeedBlur driven by the real post-remap speed each frame (no filter below 8px/f), which removes the tint and makes fast-blur to slow-sharp continuous
In the slow window the target card is picked up as it nears centre: lifts 18px, scales 4.5%, shadow elevation 5→32, while the other cards fade 30%
Cards enlarged to 540px, the real page navigation bar sits on top, a native section header (32px) sits above the rail, plus soft light, vignette and grain
